# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `aios docs reference`. Do not edit: change the code it is made from. -->

Every `aios` command. Commands that talk to a server read `AIOS_SERVER` (or `--server`)
and send `AIOS_API_KEY` as the credential; `--tenant` picks a tenant for a platform
administrator.

## aios api

Run the API process (needs --database-url).

```text
aios api [-h] [--app APP] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--tenant TENANT] [--database-url DATABASE_URL] [--cassettes CASSETTES] [--cassette-mode {replay,record,live}] [--log-level LOG_LEVEL] [--no-auth] [--tls-cert TLS_CERT] [--tls-key TLS_KEY]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--app` | App directory |
| `--host` |  |
| `--port` |  |
| `--tenant` | install the Apps for this tenant; repeat for more (default: AIOS_TENANT, local) |
| `--database-url` |  |
| `--cassettes` | record/replay directory |
| `--cassette-mode` | One of: replay, record, live. |
| `--log-level` |  |
| `--no-auth` | aios api: no sign-in, on a loopback address |
| `--tls-cert` | PEM certificate chain |
| `--tls-key` | PEM private key |

## aios app

Package, install and look after an App.

```text
aios app [-h] [--server SERVER] [--tenant TENANT] [--config CONFIG] [--yes] [--all] [--deny-tool DENY_TOOL] [--deny-scope DENY_SCOPE] [--deny-class DENY_CLASS] [--deny-host DENY_HOST] [--data {retain,export,delete}] [-o OUTPUT] {package,push,pull,install,list,show,consent,refuse,rollback,configure,export,uninstall} [target] [to]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `action` | One of: package, push, pull, install, list, show, consent, refuse, rollback, configure, export, uninstall. |
| `target` | an App's name, directory or OCI reference |
| `to` | push: the reference; rollback: the version |
| `--config` | install, configure: a JSON file |
| `--yes` | install: agree to all it asks for |
| `--all` | consent: all of it, even what was refused before |
| `--deny-tool` | consent: leave this out |
| `--deny-scope` | consent: leave this out |
| `--deny-class` | consent: leave this out |
| `--deny-host` | consent: leave this out |
| `--data` | uninstall One of: retain, export, delete. |
| `-o`, `--output` | package, pull, export: where to save it |

## aios apply

```text

```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `-f`, `--file` |  |
| `--yes` | agree to all it asks for |

## aios approvals

What people are asked to decide: list, show, answer.

```text
aios approvals [-h] [--server SERVER] [--tenant TENANT] [--comment COMMENT] [--status STATUS] [--all] [--edit NAME=VALUE] {list,show,approve,deny} [id]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `action` | One of: list, show, approve, deny. |
| `id` |  |
| `--comment` | approve, deny: recorded with the decision |
| `--status` | list: with --all, this status |
| `--all` | list: everyone's, for auditors |
| `--edit` | approve: change a parameter first (JSON, or text); repeat for more |

## aios describe

```text

```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `kind` | One of: app, run, agent, approval, task. |
| `name` | its name or id |
| `--app` | run: its App; agent: if two Apps have one by that name |

| `--database-url` |  |
| `--cassettes` | record/replay directory |
| `--cassette-mode` | One of: replay, record, live. |
| `--log-level` |  |
| `--no-auth` | aios api: no sign-in, on a loopback address |

## aios eval

Evaluation suites: run one, compare, grade by hand.

```text
aios eval [-h] [--server SERVER] [--tenant TENANT] [--app APP] [--app-dir APP_DIR] [--cassettes CASSETTES] [--cassette-mode {replay,record,live}] [--ingest INGEST] [--baseline BASELINE] [--out OUT] [--label LABEL] [--case CASE] [--grader GRADER] [--score SCORE] [--comment COMMENT] {run,list,show,compare,grade,online} [target] [other]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `action` | One of: run, list, show, compare, grade, online. |
| `target` | run: the suite's YAML; else an experiment |
| `other` | compare: the second experiment |
| `--app` | the App; run takes it from the suite if not given |
| `--app-dir` | run: here, in this process, with the App in this folder |
| `--cassettes` | run --app-dir: recorded answers |
| `--cassette-mode` | One of: replay, record, live. |
| `--ingest` | run --app-dir: documents to give it first |
| `--baseline` | run: a summary it mustn't fall below |
| `--out` | run: write the summary here |
| `--label` | run: what this experiment tries |
| `--case` | grade: the case |
| `--grader` | grade: the human grader's name |
| `--score` | grade: from 0 to 1 |
| `--comment` | grade: recorded with the grade |

## aios feedback

What people said about runs: give, list, cases.

```text
aios feedback [-h] [--server SERVER] [--tenant TENANT] [--rating {good,bad}] [--step STEP] [--correction CORRECTION] [--correct NAME=VALUE] [--comment COMMENT] [--remember] {give,list,cases} app [run_id]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `action` | One of: give, list, cases. |
| `app` |  |
| `run_id` | give: the run; list: only this run |
| `--rating` | give One of: good, bad. |
| `--step` | give: about this step, not the whole run |
| `--correction` | give: a right result, as JSON (or text) |
| `--correct` | give: the right result one field at a time (JSON, or text); repeat for more |
| `--comment` | give |
| `--remember` | give: keep it in memory too |

## aios fork

Start a finished run again from a step, side effects held back.

```text
aios fork [-h] [--server SERVER] [--tenant TENANT] --app APP --from STEP [--input INPUT] [--step-input STEP_INPUT] [--model MODEL] run_id
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `run_id` |  |
| `--app` |  |
| `--from` | the step |
| `--input` | a new input for the run, as JSON |
| `--step-input` | a new input for that step |
| `--model` | a registry entry every call uses |

## aios init

aios init <app> [--template T] | aios init agent <name> --app <dir> | aios init tool <tool.name> --app <dir>

```text
aios init [-h] [--dir DIR] [--template TEMPLATE] [--app APP] [--capability CAPABILITY] what [name]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `what` | the new App's name, or 'agent' or 'tool' |
| `name` | agent, tool: its name |
| `--dir` | an App: where to make it |
| `--template` | an App: chat (default), rag, approval, people, langgraph, openai-agents; an agent: python (default), langgraph, openai-agents |
| `--app` | agent, tool: the App's folder |
| `--capability` | agent: what it provides (its name, without -agent) |

## aios memory

Search, read and erase memory, and ingest documents.

```text
aios memory [-h] [--server SERVER] [--tenant TENANT] [--app APP] [--scope SCOPE] [-k K] [--subject SUBJECT] [--item ITEM] [--sensitivity SENSITIVITY] [--keep] {search,get,forget,ingest} [target]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--server` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `action` | One of: search, get, forget, ingest. |
| `target` | search: a query; get: an id; ingest: path or URL |
| `--app` | ingest: the App the documents belong to |
| `--scope` | repeat for more scopes |
| `-k` |  |
| `--subject` | forget: everything about this principal |
| `--item` | forget: this item |
| `--sensitivity` |  |
| `--keep` | ingest: don't remove documents that have gone |

## aios platform

```text

```

|---|---|


| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|

|---|---|

|---|---|

## aios secrets

The encrypted local secret store.

```text
aios secrets [-h] {new-key,set} ...
```

### aios secrets new-key

Print a new key for AIOS_SECRETS_KEY.

```text
aios secrets new-key [-h]
```

### aios secrets set

Store a secret; the value is read without echo.

```text
aios secrets set [-h] --tenant TENANT --app APP name
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` |  |
| `--tenant` |  |
| `--app` |  |

## aios specs

Generated JSON Schemas and the event catalog.

```text
aios specs [-h] {export,check,compat} ...
```

### aios specs check

Fail if the generated files are missing or stale.

```text
aios specs check [-h] [--dir DIR]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dir` | default: ./specs |

### aios specs compat

Fail if the schemas now would refuse events or manifests the old ones took.

```text
aios specs compat [-h] --against AGAINST
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--against` | the old specs/ folder, e.g. the base branch's |

### aios specs export

Regenerate the files under the specs directory.

```text
aios specs export [-h] [--dir DIR]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dir` | default: ./specs |
